messages:
maria: Quick problem: our Expo sample crashes on fast refresh with `crypto.getRandomValues is not a function`. Works on full reload. Anyone seen this exact fast-refresh-only pattern?

sam: yes. Usually Metro resolves the CJS main that expects Node globals. Fast refresh can re-evaluate modules before RN polyfills run. Do you have a react-native entry in package.json exports?

maria: no. package.json only has main -> dist/index.cjs.js. We import `react-native-get-random-values` in App.tsx but still hit it during hot reload.

oliver: two fixes: 1) add an explicit exports.react-native pointing to a small RN-specific file that imports the polyfill first, or 2) add a root `react-native` field/file that re-exports the RN bundle. Also ensure the RN file is the first import so polyfills run before anything else.

sam: also for typings, publish ESM .d.ts and use conditional exports so TypeScript + Metro pick the right entry. Example exports snippet: { ".": { "import": "./dist/index.mjs", "require": "./dist/index.cjs.js", "react-native": "./dist/rn/index.js" } }.

maria: good plan. I'll add a tiny `rn/setup-polyfills.js` that does `import 'react-native-get-random-values'` and point exports.react-native to it.

oliver: one more dev trick: add `if (!globalThis.crypto) require('react-native-get-random-values')` guard in the RN entry to avoid flakes during fast refresh.

devex-bot: CI flake linked: sample-app-e2e iOS fast-refresh tests failing. creating ticket #824.

maria: thanks — will push a small PR to the sample and update our package exports.
